test.create_query: CREATE TABLE crosstab_states ( k UInt64, cramers_v AggregateFunction(cramersV, UInt8, UInt8), theils_u AggregateFunction(theilsU, UInt8, UInt8) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO crosstab_states SELECT intDiv(number, 100) AS k, cramersVState(number % 100, intDiv(number, 7) % 100), theilsUState(number % 100, intDiv(number, 7) % 100) FROM numbers(2_000_000) GROUP BY k
test.query: SELECT cramersV(number, number) FROM numbers(5_000) FORMAT NULL;
SELECT cramersV(number, number) OVER (ORDER BY number) FROM numbers(5_000) FORMAT NULL;
SELECT cramersVBiasCorrected(number, number) FROM numbers(5_000) FORMAT NULL;
SELECT cramersVBiasCorrected(number, number) OVER (ORDER BY number) FROM numbers(5_000) FORMAT NULL;
SELECT theilsU(number, number) FROM numbers(5_000) FORMAT NULL;
SELECT theilsU(number, number) OVER (ORDER BY number) FROM numbers(5_000) FORMAT NULL;
SELECT contingency(number, number) FROM numbers(5_000) FORMAT NULL;
SELECT contingency(number, number) OVER (ORDER BY number) FROM numbers(5_000) FORMAT NULL;

-- Worst-case performance test for `CrossTabPhiSquaredWindowData` inherited aggregate functions SELECT cramersV(a, b) OVER (ORDER BY number) AS v FROM ( SELECT number, toUInt32(number % 1000) AS a, toUInt32(intDiv(number, 1000) % 1000) AS b FROM numbers(10_000) ) FORMAT NULL;

-- theilsU has optimized window variant that does not use `CrossTabPhiSquaredWindowData` so it is much faster than cramersV for the same data SELECT theilsU(a, b) OVER (ORDER BY number) AS v FROM ( SELECT number, toUInt32(number % 1000) AS a, toUInt32(intDiv(number, 1000) % 1000) AS b FROM numbers(10_000) ) FORMAT NULL;

SELECT finalizeAggregation(cramersVState(a, b) OVER (ORDER BY number ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) FROM (SELECT number, number % 100 AS a, intDiv(number, 7) % 100 AS b FROM numbers(3_000)) FORMAT NULL;

SELECT contingencyState(a, b) OVER (ORDER BY number ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM (SELECT number, number % 5 AS a, intDiv(number, 3) % 4 AS b FROM numbers(200_000)) FORMAT NULL;

SELECT finalizeAggregation(cramersVState(a, b) OVER (ORDER BY number ROWS BETWEEN 100 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) FROM (SELECT number, number % 30 AS a, intDiv(number, 7) % 30 AS b FROM numbers(20_000)) FORMAT NULL;

SELECT theilsUState(a, b) OVER (ORDER BY number ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM (SELECT number, number % 100 AS a, intDiv(number, 7) % 100 AS b FROM numbers(5_000)) FORMAT NULL;

SELECT finalizeAggregation(theilsUState(a, b) OVER (PARTITION BY p)) FROM (SELECT number % 100 AS p, intDiv(number, 100) % 10 AS a, (intDiv(number, 100) * 3 + intDiv(number, 1300)) % 8 AS b FROM numbers(20_000)) FORMAT NULL;
SELECT cramersVMerge(cramers_v) OVER (ORDER BY k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM crosstab_states FORMAT NULL;
SELECT theilsUMerge(theils_u) OVER (ORDER BY k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM crosstab_states FORMAT NULL;
